ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) pixels covering approximately 85-90% of the visible surface area, with low-intensity (black/dark) pixels concentrated along the peripheral trailing edge and localized internal markings.

Significant dark contiguous blob at the basal insertion point of the notch. Distributed circular low-intensity spots (mottling) primarily clustered in the upper-mid quadrant of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations present across the entire trailing edge of both lobes, characterized by jagged, non-uniform peaks and valleys isolated against the water background.
